title: Lazypi Agents Configuration
description: OpenCode-style primary and subagent configuration for Pi Coding Agent and PiChamber

defaultAgent.description: Default primary agent name for new sessions (e.g. 'blin')

agent.description: Map of agent ID to agent configuration

description.description: Short summary of the agent's role and specialty

mode.description: 'primary' = chat selector only, 'subagent' = subagent tool only, 'all' = both

prompt.description: Inline system prompt string or file reference '{file:~/path/to/persona.md}'

tools.description: Allowed tools list (e.g. ['read', 'bash', 'edit', 'write']) or boolean map

skills.description: Allowed skill names (use ['*'] for all skills, [] for no skills)

stripGlobalContext.description: When true, strips global ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md and ~/AGENTS.md to save context tokens

color.description: Optional badge color hex or token

icon.description: Sprite icon name from the PiChamber icon registry (e.g. 'robot-2', 'hammer', 'search'). Auto-resolved from the agent id/name keywords when omitted.
